title: CareMate Mobile App
description: Patient healthcare monitoring, caregiver coordination, vital tracking, and tele-consultation mobile application.
longDescription: CareMate is a full-featured mobile healthcare ecosystem built to bridge patients, caregivers, and medical practitioners. The mobile app enables real-time vitals tracking (heart rate, blood pressure, glucose levels, oxygen saturation), daily medicine reminders, emergency caregiver SOS alerts with GPS coordinates, and encrypted tele-consultations. Built with Flutter and native Kotlin modules to ensure seamless bluetooth medical device pairing and offline data caching.
features: Real-time patient vitals logging and interactive trend charts
Medicine adherence reminders & caregiver push notifications
One-tap Emergency SOS with live location broadcasting
Offline-first architecture for rural and low-connectivity zones
Role-based access controls for family members and nurses
